lines.en: Spent from all the ups and downs and ins and outs, the time has come for me to once again reflect on the day while reminiscing about all of the sex I had.
These festive laments are getting tiring without someone to rein me in, though. Just once, it’d be nice to have to pull a sleigh instead of unwrapping presents.

So while I sneak my way over to the corner of a room where things are finally wrapping up, I think to myself about gifts. How there are many people I know who possess them without having even been given any.
I think I used to be one of them. That’s what I was told at least. That I was special. That I was talented. But it became harder to take those words seriously once I was taken.
What if I was never gifted at all? What if those words were there to soften my flesh so someone could sink their teeth in? What if that’s what I did to her?
Little by little, the details are coming back to me. But I still can’t recall where things even began with Maya.
I know I was her tutor. I know it happened early. And I know I was probably fucked up at the time from losing someone else, but...how bad was it?
Was what we had really “love” at all? Because she thinks it was and, despite how wrong she’s been about practically everything ever, I can’t help but trust her when it comes to that.
Maybe I just want to, though...
Look at me — once more spending thoughts on that irrefutably abnormal teenage girl while someone else cleans my every trace out of them.
Yet, I remain hopelessly unsatisfied. Because, despite what I tell myself, no amount of sex will ever make me feel the way she did.
I think they call it “post-nut clarity” or something along that line nowadays. But you’d think that with how often I’m doing that, things would be...I don’t know. A little less blurry?
There are only a few things I know for sure, but an endless amount of things I’ve accepted that I will never understand.
The first of which has been explained to me many times — it’s the way floating dust particles manage to shimmer and glow when hit at the correct angle by light.
How something invisible to the naked eye can be made visible by pure electromagnetic radiation...or something like that.

The second thing is the romanticization of death — and how there are people who speak of it with such fervor that a single fatality appears to bring them more joy than the unwrapping of presents on Christmas morning.
The third is that secret magnets have been implanted inside of Maya and me that do nothing but cause me to feel sick to my stomach whenever she’s close by.
And she’s close by now. I felt her enter the room a minute ago.
I don’t even have to look. I just know. And I hate that I know because this one isn’t her. I shouldn’t know.
But she still has her magnet. Which means my stomach still hurts. And there’s no one I can ask for help that won’t just make me feel worse.
That’s one of the problems with being liked — never having to do things on your own. Always having a fall-back for when things get tough.
Sometimes, I feel like I’d be a much better person today if I just locked myself inside of a room after Sekai died and let my muscles atrophy without Ami there to watch.
I’d probably be writhing in pain and covered in piss, but at least I’d have kept away from dragging everyone else into an endless hell.
The worst part of all, though, is that I know it won’t end with me. And that one of these girls will follow in my footsteps one day.
They’ll hurt someone else. They’ll haunt someone else. And that will go on and on and on and on because that’s how this world works. But for once, I’m not talking about time.
Is there anything I can do to stop it?
Please tell me so I know what not to do.
There it is again — that unending desire to hold something. To be held.
How nice it would be if only she fit in the palm of my hand.
: Well, it feels like you do. And I won’t blame you if you do after that stuff I said about Niki.
: You don’t like her. I get it. That won’t make me hate you, though. It’d take a lot more than that.
: Like what? Stealing the body of your one true love?
: I...get nervous and...mean when I have to...talk about stuff. And I guess that...
: I guess that what I’m trying to say is...if being around me really is causing you pain, I’m...sorry.
: I’m sorry for...following you and...I’m sorry for forcing you to talk to me and...have sex with me and...all of that stuff that makes me feel better. But from my perspective-
: I know what it’s like from your perspective. You don’t have to tell me.
: It’s not your fault this happened, it’s mine. And holding that against you isn’t doing either one of us any good apparently.
: As fucking...inconceivable as it is, it’s become...glaringly clear to me that some things about this place and...about us are...not even close to the way they seem.
: But I don’t know how they became like that or...how long they’ve been that way. Or when they’ll go back. Or if they’ll go back...
: The fact that I never gave up on you must count for something, right? Because that’s still me. That’s what I’m bound to turn into if things stay like this forever.

: What happens if you get sent back again? Or what happens if I get sent back again? Are we really just going to keep hurting each other for the rest of our infinite existence? Is that what we have to do?
: Are there really...no moments at all that you look back on and think, “this is what makes the pain worth it?”
: Something...something...blah, blah, blah...this isn’t supposed to be easy or...whatever.
: Do you want to know what you’ll turn into if you stay like this?

: A cruel, manipulative, over-protective, gaslighting bitch who refuses to listen to anyone but herself. Someone who’d stab even her best friend in the back in exchange for the slightest hint of personal progression.

: Someone incessantly incorrigible, who does nothing but mock and belittle everyone around her from the top of some pedestal she created out of hers and everyone else’s broken dreams and unrealized desires.
: Someone so closed off that, even when the man she’s been chasing after for an indeterminate amount of time shows up, it takes her years to even realize it.
: And even then, she’s someone so self-absorbed, yet so fucking cowardly that it takes her even longer to do anything about it.
: Maybe she was right about that part, though. I did effectively kill her after all. But that just goes to show that I suck too — which is something both of us are already well aware of.
: We’ve both been pretty shitty from the get-go, huh?
: Except I don’t know the first thing about how you even got that way, so I just have to assume it was me who did it to you.
: You never told me anything about your past...About where you came from or...even any specific details about how we met and our time together.
: Back when it was the other you, I could easily just chalk that up to be something like, “Oh, she’s just trying to protect me.” Or, “This might fuck my brain up in some weird sort of way.”
: But I also feel like you won’t tell me either, and you don’t know the first thing about all of that time-fuckery stuff. You’re just...not the type of girl who likes to share, I think.
: Neither are you. I always had to figure out everything out on my own. But that’s why we worked so well.
: We could be with each other and...touch each other and...and that would be enough. We didn’t need to talk. And...I think that’s fine. I don’t have much else to give anyway.
: There it is again. Textbook Maya — closing me out despite having her leash wrapped around my neck.
: No, Akira. I...I don’t really remember.
: You, I remember! That part is super clear. Graphic, yes. But clear as day.
: It’s...what came before you that’s just...gone.
: That sounds a lot like me for the first several years of this...reincarnation or whatever you want to call it. Maybe not as bad, though. I didn’t even know my name at first.
: Well, I definitely know that. It’s really just...everything from before we met that feels...blank. Like that part of my life was just never filled in or something.
: Maybe you’re just repressing something? That’s what I was doing.
: Maybe...But if that’s the case, do you think I’m better off trying to dig it up? Or...
: No. Keep it buried. Digging it up won’t do anything but further complicate things and send you spiraling into chaotic debauchery.
: Heh...Chaotic debauchery...sounds kind of fun. Don’t you think? Hahah...hah...
: My birthday is coming up soon and...
: And there’s this...festival I want to go to.
: I, like...get that things are kind of...weird with us right now. But I...
: If you, like...wanted to go with me-
: I don’t think that’s...a good idea...
: I can...go some other year or...
: I went there with her and...
: We can...do something else though. Like...maybe not for your birthday, but...
: You’ll spend time with me again?...
: I’ve been...holding things against you, that...I probably shouldn’t.
: So if there’s anything you have in mind-
: I think I...might need to buy...heavier clothes or...something like that.
: We can just...hang out. It doesn’t have to-
: Yeah! Th-That’s what I was gonna say.
We remain right there until we’re the only two left.
It’s just like when the world was ending.
It appears that you’re ready to talk to her again!
Don’t get too close, though! You saw what happened last time!
But if it still feels wrong, maybe getting closer is for the best after all?
Is another taste of her forbidden fruit so tantalizing that you’d risk damning humanity to fill your stomach?
You have many things to figure out about yourself! About what you want! About where to go!
And there’s no one around to hold you back any longer.
You can eat as much fruit as you want.
: It’s been...getting kind of cold lately, and...I mean...if you’re not busy...I kind of want to...buy something warmer?
: Yeah...Yeah, we can do that. I’ll...
: Dear, Touka — I sincerely apologize for ducking out early. But, after much consideration, I realized that the likelihood of Sensei making love to me tonight was very low and-
: No wonder I’m so talented and cool.
: Hey, it’s kind of cold out here.
: Would you mind if I maybe...you know.
: It’s not important to you, is it?
: Huh?...No! No, I don’t mind. Yeah. You can have it.
: Do you...want me to call you a cab? Or...is there anything else I can do to-
: If there’s anything else, I’ll let you know.
: And so she handed that old winter garment over to the girl — its nostalgic scent still clinging to each and every fiber.
: There was a thought...a minor one...that perhaps things could still work out if she kept it for herself. As a memento, of sorts.
: That was all it was, though. A thought. And a fleeting one at that. Because...
: Whether she liked it or not...
